## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/context-gauge.sh:56` — `runs_rows <project folder>`: reads the ledger via `ledger_dir:38`, prints claims, human blocks, lane actions, capped at six (`:76`).
- `hooks/context-gauge.sh:91` — `pdir="$(jq -r '.workspace.project_dir // .workspace.current_dir // .cwd // empty')"` — the folder whose ledger feeds the rows.
- `hooks/context-gauge.sh:93–97` — `compact_at` is read from `<dir>/.claude/project-status.json` with `jq … 2>/dev/null`, silently defaulting; the pattern to follow.
- `hooks/context-gauge.sh:100` — `[ -n "$pdir" ] && runs_rows "$pdir"` — the single call site to guard.
- `tests/smoke.sh:5498` — existing mutation `sed` targets the exact line `[ -n "$pdir" ] && runs_rows "$pdir"`; if the call line changes, this sed pattern must change too (and its `cmp` guard catches a non-applying sed).
- `tests/smoke.sh:5486` — `l3_rin` passes only `current_dir` → `pdir` = that folder; in the worktree case (`:5493`) `pdir` = `$l3_rn/wt`, so the fixture `project-status.json` must exist in the worktree too (write it to both, or commit it before `worktree add`).
- `tests/smoke.sh:6127` — `la_gauge` uses `project_dir: $l3_t`; `$l3_t/.claude/project-status.json` exists there (restored from `ps.bak` at `:5504`) and must carry `gauge_rows: true` for `:6128` to keep passing.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Status line never fails: every jq read is `2>/dev/null` with a default (`context-gauge.sh:13`, `:94–98`).
- Mutation checks are `sed` on a copy of the gauge + `cmp` guard that the mutation applied (`tests/smoke.sh:5498`).
- New specs cite scoped FR ids: `gauge-rows-opt-in/FR-NNN` (spec carries `<!-- req-coverage: scoped -->`).
